_note: Every numeric parameter used in paper.md Section 5. status: verified = checked against the cited public source (accessed 2026-09-23); assumption = illustrative value, not a measured market price.

p_in.status: verified at 1.25 and 3.00 [94,95,96]; 5.00 upper end assumption
p_in.source: [94] GPT-5, [95] Gemini 2.5 Computer Use, [96] Claude Sonnet 4.6 price pages

p_out.status: verified points 10 and 15 [94,95,96]; range ends assumption

p_in_point.source: [96] Claude Sonnet 4.6; used for the hybrid sensitivity table

t_in.unit: input LLM tokens per VLM action (one screenshot + prompt)
t_in.measured: 613-1,586 per call, three small VLMs (measurement/results/summary.json, 2026-09-23; paper §5.7)

t_out.unit: output LLM tokens per VLM action

n_actions.measured: 11-18.5 VLM calls (median) for a five-field form, pure agent (measurement/results/summary.json, 2026-09-23; paper §5.7)

f_example.unit: fraction of steps using the VLM

vlm_step_latency.status: assumption (no public per-step figure; consistent with OSWorld-Human, arXiv:2506.16042)
vlm_step_latency.measured: 0.77-6.18 s median per call, three small VLMs (measurement/results/summary.json, 2026-09-23; paper §5.7)

script_step_latency.measured: 0.47 s median per xdotool action (measurement/results/summary.json, 2026-09-23; paper §5.7)

proxy_commodity.status: UNVERIFIED (Bright Data page unreachable 2026-09-23; earlier-recorded from 5.88/GB); TODO(author)

sweep_n.unit: actions per attempt in the hybrid table

tier1_device_price.unit: USD per used PAT-capable Apple device (iPhone)
tier1_device_price.status: assumption (used-market listings could not be retrieved programmatically)
tier1_device_price.source: TODO(author): cite a dated used-market price snapshot

tier1_ops_per_device_month.unit: USD per device per month (proxy/SIM, power, management)
tier1_ops_per_device_month.status: vendor-reported (anti-detect vendor blog, 10-device farm monthly total / 10); not independently verified

tier1_cloud_mac_hourly.unit: USD/hour, AWS EC2 mac2.metal on-demand, 24 h minimum
tier1_cloud_mac_hourly.status: verified (price aggregator + AWS 24 h minimum rule); whether PAT issuance works on EC2 Mac hosts is unverified

tier1_rate_limit_sweep.unit: clearance tokens per device per origin per day
tier1_rate_limit_sweep.status: assumption (Apple does not publish attester/issuer rate limits; RFC 9577-style rate-limited issuance leaves the limit to the issuer)

ppi_price.unit: USD per 1,000 installs (Windows, 2011; Asia low end, US/UK high end)

prices_usd_per_mtok.unit: USD per 1M LLM tokens, keyed by API model id (used by measurement/analyze.py)

prices_eur_per_mtok.unit: EUR per 1M LLM tokens, keyed by Melious API model id (used by measurement/analyze.py)
